```{r}
# Load in combined_augmented_data.csv
combined_augmented_data = read.csv("combined_augmented_data.csv")
```

```{r}
# Outlier removal function shouldnt be here, it should happen to the training
# and testing set separately I think
outlier_removed_augment = main_outliers_detection_function(combined_augmented_data, 0.1,
                                                           impute = 'NA')

knn_impute_rec = recipe(~., data = outlier_removed_augment) %>% 
  step_impute_knn(all_predictors(), neighbors = 3)

write.csv(file = 'augmented_data_knn_imputed_outliers.csv', x=knn_imputed_augment, row.names = F)

DR_Viz(combined_augmented_data)
DR_Viz(knn_imputed_augment)
```

```{r}
# Percent correct by concentration for all data
percent_correct_visualization = function(dataset, color){
  viz = dataset %>% mutate(across(concentration, round, 4)) %>%
    mutate_at('concentration', as.factor) %>% mutate(match = ifelse(predictions == labels, 1, 0)) %>% 
                          group_by(concentration) %>%
    summarize(num_correct = sum(match),
              total = n()) %>%
    mutate(percent_correct = (round(num_correct / total, 4)) * 100) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = concentration, y = percent_correct)) +
    geom_bar(stat = 'identity',
             fill = color) +
    geom_text(aes(label = percent_correct),
              vjust  = 1.5,
              color = 'white') +
    theme_classic() +
    ylab('Percent Correct') +
    xlab('Concentration') +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.001))
  
  return(viz)
}
```

```{r}
DR_Viz = function(dataset){
  std.err = function(x, na.rm = T) sd(x, na.rm = T)/sqrt(length(x))
  dataset %>% select(-Replicate) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(target_vector, Conc.),
               names_to = 'pairs',
               values_to = 'fluorescence') %>% 
  group_by(Conc., target_vector, pairs) %>%
  summarise(average_fluorescence = mean(fluorescence),
            se = std.err(fluorescence)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=Conc., y=average_fluorescence, color = target_vector))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=average_fluorescence-se, ymax = average_fluorescence+se), width = 0.2)+
  facet_wrap('pairs', scales = 'free')+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,5))+
  scale_x_log10()+
  theme_minimal()
}
```

```{r}
prototype_function = function(dataset,
             prop,
             updample = T,
             upsample_ratio = 1){
  initial_split = initial_split(dataset,
                                prop=0.7,
                                strata = 'target_vector')
  train_data = training(initial_split)
  test_data = testing(initial_split)
  
  # step_rose skip=T by default so the subsequent bake step wont actually do
  # anything
  upsample_recipe = recipe(target_vector~.,
                                   data = train_data) %>% 
    step_rose(target_vector) %>% 
    prep()
  
  upsampled_train_data = upsample_recipe %>% 
    bake(new_data = NULL)
  
  # If skip is left TRUE, then the following code is required
  baked = upsample_recipe %>% 
    bake(new_data = train_data) %>% 
    count(class, name = "baked")
  
  upsampled_data = bind_rows(train_data, upsampled_train_data)
}



prototype_function
```

```{r}
# Upsample testing, take a data set and upsample over four class, the remove the recipe if necessary
# I want to plot the results of each upsampling algorithm in a lower dimensional space (UMAP?)
umap_viz = function(dataset){
  # umap_param_grid = grid_latin_hypercube(
  #   n_neighbors = 
  #   min_dist = 
  #   n_components = 
  #   metric = 
  # )
  # 
  # umap_subplots = list()
  dataset = dataset %>% select(-c(Replicate)) %>% mutate(across(Conc., round, 3))
  
  umap_rec = recipe( ~ ., data = dataset) %>% 
    update_role(Conc., target_vector, new_role = "id") %>% 
    step_normalize(all_predictors()) %>% 
    step_umap(all_predictors(), 
              num_comp = 2,
              neighbors = 30,
              min_dist = 0.1) %>% 
    prep()
  
  umap_embedding = juice(umap_rec)
  
  umap_embedding_plot = umap_embedding %>% 
    ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, label = Conc.)) + 
    geom_point(aes(color = target_vector), alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    geom_text(check_overlap = T, hjust = "inward", family = "IBMPlexSans") +
    labs(color = NULL)
  
  print(umap_embedding_plot)
  
}

umap_viz(combined_augmented_data %>% filter(Conc. > 0.1) %>% filter(Conc. < 249)) 

# missing values imputed using k-nearest neighbors using the entire (unsplit)
# data set
umap_viz(knn_imputed_augment %>% filter(Conc. > 0.1 & Conc. < 249))


```

```{r}
# Upsample testing, take a data set and upsample over four class, the remove the recipe if necessary
# I want to plot the results of each upsampling algorithm in a lower dimensional space (UMAP?)
umap_viz = function(dataset){

    neighbors(),
    min_dist()
  )
  
  print(umap_param_grid)

  umap_subplots = list()
  dataset = dataset %>% select(-c(Replicate)) %>% mutate(across(Conc., round, 3))

    update_role(Conc., target_vector, new_role = "id") %>% 
    step_normalize(all_predictors()) %>% 
    step_umap(all_predictors(), 
              num_comp = 2,
              neighbors = 30,
              min_dist = 0.1) %>% 
    prep()
  
  umap_embedding = juice(umap_rec)
  
  umap_embedding_plot = umap_embedding %>% 
    ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, label = Conc.)) + 
    geom_point(aes(color = target_vector), alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    geom_text(check_overlap = T, hjust = "inward", family = "IBMPlexSans") +
    labs(color = NULL)
  
  print(umap_embedding_plot)
  
}
```

```{r}
# Random forest
random_forest = function(object, mtry = 1){
  mod = rand_forest(mode = "classification", trees = 1000, mtry = mtry) %>% 
    set_engine("ranger") %>% 
    fit(outcome~., data = analysis(object))
  
  holdout_pred = predict(mod, assessment(object) %>% select(-outcome)) %>% 
    bind_cols(assessment) %>% select(outcome)
  
  accuracy(holdout_pred, truth = outcome, estimate = .pred_class)$.estimate
}
```
